title: Spatial canvas
description: A spatial canvas: its leaves (colour, geometry, sides, arrowheads, routing), the nodes, edges, lines and comments built from them, and the canvas itself.

CanvasColorPreset.description: One of the six numbered preset colours of JSON Canvas 1.0.

CanvasColorHex.x-wb-message: must be a preset "1"–"6" or a 6-digit hex color such as "#1a2b3c"

CanvasColor.description: A canvas colour: a numbered preset or a 6-digit hex string (JSON Canvas 1.0).

NodePosition.description: A coordinate on the canvas: a finite real, where JSON Canvas 1.0 has integer pixels.

NodeSize.description: The width or height of a node: a finite real number that is not negative. Zero is valid.

x.description: Distance from the canvas origin along x.

y.description: Distance from the canvas origin along y.

Bends.description: Points to draw a line through, in order; at most 64, since more is a defect, not a drawing.

EdgeSide.description: A side of a node an edge may attach to.

Arrowhead.description: The arrowhead drawn at one end of an edge.

EdgeRoutingStyle.description: How an edge gets from one endpoint to the other once the router must step around something.

LineJumps.description: Whether a small arc is drawn where one edge crosses another.

EdgeRouting.description: The resolved answer to how edges are drawn; never a stored shape.

style.description: How an edge steps around an obstacle.

lineJumps.description: Whether crossings are drawn with an arc.

NodeId.description: The id of a node, edge, line or comment: a string that is not empty.

DocumentId.description: A document id: a canonical ULID.

OkfActor.description: Who or what acted: a non-blank single-line string, held to no fixed shape.

OkfTimestamp.description: An ISO 8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset (OKF section 5).
OkfTimestamp.x-wb-message: an OKF timestamp is an ISO 8601 datetime with an explicit UTC offset

ExtensionFacets.description: Extension facets by namespace.name/vN key, each payload carried unvalidated.

NodeResource.description: What a node shows: a media type and either its content or where to find it. Hand-written in Zod for the refinements a schema cannot state.

mimeType.description: The media type of what the node shows.

content.description: The content itself, when the node carries it.

location.description: Where the content is, when the node points at it.

subpath.description: A fragment of the location, written with a leading hash.

NodeEmbed.description: The document a node shows inline.

versionRef.description: The saved version to show, when not the current one.

BackgroundStyle.description: How a frame background image fills the frame.

SharedNodeFields.description: What every node has, whatever it shows.

width.x-wb-describe: Box width; text wraps at it. Omit it for the default.

height.x-wb-describe: Box height. Omit it and a text box is made tall enough for its text; a named one too short for the text is refused with the height it needs.

embed.description: The document this node shows inline.

tags.description: What this box is classified as.

SpatialNode.description: A box that may show a resource; one that shows nothing is a frame.

resource.description: What this node shows. Absent: it shows nothing, and is a frame.

backgroundStyle.description: How the background fills the frame.

EdgeEnd.description: One end of an edge, which is a relation: it names a node, never a bare point.

node.description: The node this end attaches to.
node.x-wb-describe: The node this end attaches to.

side.description: The side of the node to attach to.
side.x-wb-describe: The side of the node to attach to. Omit it: the router picks the side that keeps the line clear of other boxes, and a named side is kept even through one.

end.description: The arrowhead drawn at this end.
end.x-wb-describe: The arrowhead drawn at this end.

LineEndNode.description: The end of a line that sits on a node.

kind.description: Which arm of the line end this is.

node.description: The node this end attaches to.
node.x-wb-describe: The node this end attaches to.

side.description: The side of the node to attach to.
side.x-wb-describe: The side of the node to attach to. Omit it: the router picks the side that keeps the line clear of other boxes, and a named side is kept even through one.

end.description: The arrowhead drawn at this end.
end.x-wb-describe: The arrowhead drawn at this end.

LineEndPoint.description: The end of a line that sits at a free point on the canvas.

kind.description: Which arm of the line end this is.

point.x-wb-describe: Where this end sits, in canvas coordinates.

end.description: The arrowhead drawn at this end.
end.x-wb-describe: The arrowhead drawn at this end.

LineEnd.description: One end of a line, which is ink: a node, or a bare point on the canvas.

from.description: The node the relation starts at.
from.x-wb-describe: The node the relation starts at.

to.description: The node the relation ends at.
to.x-wb-describe: The node the relation ends at.

bends.description: Points the line is drawn through, in order.

tags.description: What this relation is classified as.

CanvasLine.description: Ink: a stroke that may end nowhere and asserts no relation.

from.x-wb-describe: Where the line starts: on a node (`{kind:"node",node}`) or at a free point on the canvas (`{kind:"point",point}`).

to.x-wb-describe: Where the line ends: on a node (`{kind:"node",node}`) or at a free point on the canvas (`{kind:"point",point}`).

bends.description: Points the line is drawn through, in order.

CanvasComment.description: A comment as the canvas draws it: one pin and one bubble.

SpatialCanvas.description: A spatial canvas: nodes, the edges between them and the ink drawn over them.

lines.description: The ink; absent when there is none.

tags.description: The tags of the board itself.
